heathrow express.name: Heathrow Express
heathrow express.cost: From £25 standard, £32 business (cheaper if booked 90 days ahead)
heathrow express.where: T2/T3 station (Central) and T5 station. No T4 stop — use free transit train from T4.
heathrow express.notes: Fastest option to central London. No stops.

elizabeth line.name: Elizabeth line
elizabeth line.where: T2/T3 station, T4 station, T5 station
elizabeth line.notes: Best value for speed. Stops at Hayes, Ealing Broadway, Paddington, Bond Street, Liverpool Street, Canary Wharf.

tube.name: Piccadilly line (Underground)
tube.to: Central London (Knightsbridge, Piccadilly Circus, King's Cross)
tube.cost: About £6.30 with contactless / Oyster (daily cap applies)
tube.where: T2/T3 station, T4 station, T5 station
tube.notes: Cheapest direct rail option. Slower than Elizabeth line but goes deeper into central London.

bus.name: National Express coach
bus.where: Heathrow Central Bus Station (between T2 and T3), and T5
bus.notes: Cheapest option but slowest. Good for luggage.

taxi.name: Black taxi
taxi.cost: About £60-100 depending on traffic and destination
taxi.notes: Metered, no booking needed. Can take credit cards.

uber.name: Uber / Bolt / minicab
uber.cost: About £35-70 depending on traffic and surge
uber.where: Designated rideshare pickup zones at each terminal (signposted)
uber.notes: Often cheaper than black taxis. Pickup zone may be a short walk from arrivals.
